{{Quote|There will come a day when all must fight. We are too few.|Yark to Tusken elders|<ref name="Star Wars: Kenobi" />}}
'''Yark''' was the leader of his tribe and the the father of [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] and adopted father of [[K'Sheek]]. Yark allowed both his daughters to be trained as warriors, and defended the criticism against them.<ref name="Star Wars: Kenobi" />
